title: fuzz: add missing profiles to fuzz_decompress
description: The fuzz_decompress.rs target only tests CoapUdpLinkLocalProfile and Icmpv6EchoProfile. Add CoapUdpGlobalProfile, RplDioProfile, and RplDaoProfile to ensure complete fuzz coverage of all packet parsing code paths.
close_reason: Added CoapUdpGlobalProfile, RplDioProfile, and RplDaoProfile to fuzz_decompress.rs. All five profiles now have fuzz coverage. Tests pass.
